text:
Mia (Growth): quick one — post-launch cleanup for the webinar + feature launch landing pages. We spotted a few dangling internal links and some old UTM-laden URLs that should redirect. can someone own a short checklist? :clipboard:

Sam (SEO): I can run a quick crawl and surface the high-priority redirects. will do a 2-pass: 1) 5xx/4xx + canonical mismatches 2) internal link graph for orphaned pages. target by EOD.

Leo (Content): thanks. please flag any landing pages where anchor text needs to be changed for keyword alignment — i'll update microcopy.

Sam (SEO): plan:
- run Screaming Frog export -> filter status codes, canonical, rel=prev/next
- run ahrefs/sitecrawl for incoming internal links
- grep for legacy UTM patterns: `grep -R "utm_" public/landing -n`
- generate redirect map CSV: `source_path, target_path, redirect_type, reason`

Anya (PM): EOD is tight — can we do a prioritized list (P0 = customer funnels + registration pages, P1 = webinar assets, P2 = blog references)? i'd rather we ship P0 by EOD and the rest tomorrow.

Sam (SEO): yep — i'll mark P0 in the CSV. also will add a quick score for traffic impact (GA sessions last 90d).

Mia (Growth): perfect. add column `notify_channels` so growth ops and support get a ping when redirects deploy. also include rollback note.

seo-bot: automated note: last crawl snapshot for /webinar-signup captured 12 broken internal links. See /crawls/2026-03-20-landing-report.csv

Sam (SEO): putting the CSV in the marketing board: https://redwood.example/boards/marketing/launch-cleanup (will attach crawl export).

Leo (Content): quick question — for multi-step funnels we should prefer 302 temporary if we're testing messaging? or 301?

Mia (Growth): if it's A/B or temporary messaging, use 302. for canonicalization/permanent fixes use 301. document each decision in `notes` column.

Anya (PM): small ops ask: can we batch redirects by host so infra can rollout with minimal touch? Sam, add `host` and estimated rollout window to CSV.

Sam (SEO): done. i'll post P0 CSV now and @Mia @Leo @Anya please review and thumbs up. :thumbsup:

Mia (Growth): on it — scanning now. will reply inline if any anchor text tweaks needed.

Leo (Content): review in 10. if anything urgent i'll push a microcopy change PR to content repo.

Sam (SEO): latest last note — watch for internal links in the webinar email templates (sendgrid). those often have old query params. adding `email_templates` column.

Mia (Growth): solid. thanks team — we'll sync in the 2pm standup if there are blockers.

Anya (PM): closing loop: owner = Sam, ETA P0 EOD, P1 tomorrow noon. leaving thread for any async followups.
